Main question: What information is presented to the state-space model?
Representative design choices: Nodes, neighborhoods, walks, metapaths, spectral components, snapshots, higher-order cells

Main question: How are graph-derived representations ordered and traversed?
Representative design choices: Structural ranking, traversal, temporal ordering, type-aware or rank-aware ordering, uni-/bi-/multi-directional scanning

Main question: Does graph information directly affect the selective state dynamics?
Representative design choices: Graph-conditioned B_t, C_t, or Delta_t; modified transition; graph-aware state-space operator

Architectural aspect: Integration with graph propagation or attention
Main question: How is the SSM combined with other graph-learning mechanisms?
Representative design choices: Parallel local–global branches, graph encoder followed by Mamba, embedded state evolution, attention–SSM hybrids (classified by how the SSM branch is integrated)
